thread:
tobias: FYI opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/8429 - implements routing fallback behavior referenced in RFC https://r.redwood.com/rfcs/2874. Blocking merge until arch signoff. Ping @arch-team :eyes:
elizabethbot: automated note: Please ensure PR includes canary plan and test checklist as per eng release playbook.
elestia (archbot): RFC 2874 linked here: https://r.redwood.com/rfcs/2874 - reviewers, check section 3 (fallback semantics) for compatibility notes.
elaine: can you paste the canary plan + exact metrics we'll watch? want to slot this into the oncall rotation.
tobias: canary: 24h on staging dedicated cluster, ramp 5% -> 25% over first 2h. Metrics: p50/p95 latency, error rate, token-cost delta, and a small eval set regression check. Short config in PR: ```routing:
  fallback_enabled: true
  fallback_model: rwd-lite-quant
  canary:
    duration_hours: 24
    ramp: [5, 25]
```
ashok: quick read: main concern is KV cache behavior during failovers. need explicit note on cache prefixing + migration and an opt-out flag for critical customers. Also drop in perf numbers at 1k concurrent sessions so we know cost impact.
tobias: added perf numbers in PR comments: p50 80ms, p95 210ms at 1k sessions on g5x hardware. KV migration: prefix-preserve strategy, no global invalidation. added opt-out flag `routing.fallback_opt_out_customers` to config and documented it.
ashok: thanks. update looks better. I still want a short test plan for cache edge cases and please update RFC section 3.2 to mention prefix-preserve behavior. After that I can give arch-ack.
elaine: I can run the canary tomorrow morning and monitor cost/latency + run the eval set checks.
noah: if arch gives ack after changes, when can we merge? any rough ETA?
tobias: I can push the updates today, then request re-review. probably can be ready to merge within 24-36h after ack + canary.
ashok: ping me when it's updated. I'll do final pass and give ACK. plan: after ACK we'll let canary run 24h and then merge if no regression.
tobias: sounds good, thanks :thumbsup: pinging @ashok when I've pushed.

--- later ---

tobias: pushed changes and test plan, updated RFC 3.2 reference in PR comment: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rfcs/pull/2874 (note: small amendment describing KV prefix behavior).
ashok: scanned quickly :+1: one doc nit in the test plan but provisionally ACKing. I'll do formal sign-off after canary completes and I verify the cache edge-case tests.
elaine: started canary at 2026-03-16T09:15:00Z, currently at 5% traffic. I'll post periodic checks to the PR.
noah: thanks, keeping an eye.
archbot: deploybot: canary started for PR #8429 at 2026-03-16T09:15:00Z
tobias: thanks all — will collect metrics and post a 24h summary.
